messages:
Samir Gupta: Found this gem in the office kitchen fridge, thought of you all :joy:
Rachel Kim: OMG that dog in a tiny mustache is chef's kiss :clap: :joy:
Ava Martin: I will not be surprised if this becomes the official mascot for our next release
Samir Gupta: propose the feature flag name: 'mustache-mode' — toggles tiny hats on avatars in the console :stuck_out_tongue:
Rachel Kim: telemetry spike predictions already incoming, please don't actually ship this without a canary :eyes:
deploy-bot: :robot_face: FYI: 'mustache-mode' not found in feature flags. Also, do not add UI changes that require DB migrations at 3pm on Friday.
Ava Martin: Noted. Sticker idea created in #design-requests — assigning to @Jordan for mockups :sparkles:
Samir Gupta: Adding to my todo: design stickers, mockup mustache overlays, prototype mustache-mode toggle (P3)
Rachel Kim: If we do this, we must have a toggle called "beard-of-the-week" next week
Samir Gupta: Deal.
(ended with 3 reactions, including :joy:, :thumbsup:, :eyes:)
